description: Audit newline-delimited JSON logs against a contract, and across the whole set. The two findings that need every line at once: a field whose type varies between lines, so an index either rejects the minority or coerces them silently; and a message field with nearly as many distinct values as lines, which is interpolated rather than templated so nothing groups and cost scales with volume. Also reports absent required fields, a level differing only in case, and a timestamp with no offset. Pay 190000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract.description: The rules to apply. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

field_types.description: Per field, one of string, number, boolean, object, array or null.

message_field.description: Defaults to message. Used for the templating check.

permitted_levels.description: A value differing only in case is reported under its own code, since a filter matching one does not match the other.

logs.description: Newline-delimited JSON, one object per line, at most 20000 lines. A line that does not parse is reported rather than discarded. Nothing is fetched: no backend is queried and no credential is accepted, so the data supplied is the whole input.

name: log_schema_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every line parsed and every check that ran found nothing.

fields.description: Per field, the types observed and how many lines carried each. Names and types only, never values.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Log Schema Contract Audit
